semantics: Run the tool screen on (request, response). A response whose error member is a JSON object is an API refusal: the result keeps only apiVersion, requestId and error (code, reason, message, detail, retryable, retryAfterSec, suggestion, notices) and counts as pass. Any other error value is checked like a body without one. Otherwise expect.result is pass, or fail with the first failing rule in the order P1..P6, G1..G4; a failure returns only {error:{code:address_not_allowed,message,retryable:false}}. A passing plan keeps only the documented plan keys with calls cut to chainId, from, to, data and value; a passing offer keeps only the documented offer keys with typedData cut to domain, types.ReceiveWithAuthorization, primaryType and message; a phase-2 answer keeps requestId, state, payTo and deadline. When expect.output is present the result must equal it exactly. For get_gas, context.nowSec is the clock in seconds for the order deadline bound (deadline <= nowSec + 900 for a same-chain offer off chain 1, else + 1200, plus 120 s skew); run without context.nowSec, use the current time.
